desired_configuration.surface: Shopify Google & YouTube > Settings > Product feed > Product sync
desired_configuration.desired: Automatically sync products using the Google & YouTube app
desired_configuration.action: Read current mode and receiving account; save automatic mode only if different and binding is Merchant513542500.

desired_configuration.surface: Shopify Google & YouTube > Product sync > Countries and languages
desired_configuration.desired: Every currently served country/language supported by the actual app and account, with real shipping and localized purchasable landing pages
desired_configuration.action: Reconcile the saved65-country/21-language matrix with actual account options and received sources; preserve existing identities and rules.
Enable if off after confirming it follows enabled Shopify Markets and shipping destinations.
Read setting, country eligibility and account issues; correct nonspend setup if needed.

desired_configuration.desired: App-owned sources receive and refresh current intended offers; no stale removed offers; complete approved country-language coverage recorded
desired_configuration.action: Bind source IDs, language, feed label, offer IDs, country sets, refresh times, quota, issues and per-destination status. Do not infer this from Shopify publication counts.

lifecycle.event: New product becomes ACTIVE and available on Online Store and Google channel
lifecycle.expected: Native app creates applicable variant/language offers in supported configured markets.

lifecycle.event: Price, availability, product content or translation changes
lifecycle.expected: Native app refreshes the supported offers with accurate localized data; verify actual translated coverage.

lifecycle.event: Variant is added or removed on an ACTIVE product
lifecycle.expected: Create or withdraw only its mapped language/feed-label offer identities, preserving the parent grouping and remaining variants.

lifecycle.event: Product becomes DRAFT, ARCHIVED or UNLISTED, is removed from a relevant channel, or is deleted in Shopify
lifecycle.expected: Withdraw corresponding source-owned offers; verify absence or non-serving status in Merchant. Exact latency remains unverified.

lifecycle.event: Product returns to ACTIVE and both channels
lifecycle.expected: Native app can restore eligible offers under their retained identity. Avoid Merchant UI archive as routine lifecycle control because feed updates cannot undo it.
Use current enabled Markets, published languages and shipping; reconcile actual Google support and source ownership before adding/removing target coverage.

conditional_gaps.condition: A genuine future ACTIVE product misses Google channel inclusion despite native automatic sync
conditional_gaps.remedy: Use supported Shopify Flow Product created plus Product status updated, conditioned on ACTIVE and Online Store availability, with selected Google channel publication. Do not set Google publication.autoPublish through AppCatalog mutation whose target-specific support and lifecycle fit are unestablished.
conditional_gaps.status: NOT BUILT_OR_ENABLED; need native evidence and installed Flow capability.

conditional_gaps.condition: Supported translated offers are absent from app-owned sources
conditional_gaps.remedy: Add only uncovered primary language/pricing partitions through a maintained source with refresh and deletion reconciliation. A supplemental source cannot create missing language offers.
conditional_gaps.status: NOT CREATED; actual receiving source identity/quota/coverage required. No static upload presented as automation.

rejected_path.rollback_if_ever_supported: Same target autoPublish:false would restore the flag but would not undo subsequent publication membership; no rollback executed.

acceptance_required: All current ACTIVE intended variants reconciled to received Merchant identities.
Each served and supported country-language pair has received eligible offers or an explicit evidence-backed exclusion; 21 languages do not by themselves prove all1365 requested pairs.
Actual later source change and withdrawal are observed at Merchant; no fabricated receipt or latency claim.

No paid enablement or unsupported customer claims.
